reflection: Round 1: nothing passed; every factor helped in 2023 and 2025 but hurt in 2024, suggesting regime-dependent features that overfit in calm trending years. Ratio/dispersion features were weak; the gap factor helped LR in some years. Existing top factors are volatility and MSFT return, so I will try smoother, bounded transformations (ranks via position in rolling range, signed gaps) and mean-reversion vs. peers. I will also test volume-related and multi-day relative moves, which are less regime-sensitive.

lessons.name: aapl_vol_ratio_5_20
lessons.lesson: Ratio of short to long vol is nearly a rescaled copy of AAPL_volatility_5d and its level information is lost, so it was noise in 2022 and 2024.

lessons.name: msft_return_zscore_20d
lessons.lesson: Standardizing MSFT's return mostly duplicates MSFT_return_1d, helping RF slightly but being unstable in 2024 when MSFT vol was low.

lessons.name: aapl_close_position_in_range
lessons.lesson: Intraday close location carries a weak mean-reversion/momentum signal that flips sign across regimes, so it helped only in 2023 and 2025.

lessons.name: qqq_vol_ratio_5_20
lessons.lesson: Market vol-change ratio is new information but has no stable link to Apple's next-day direction.

lessons.name: aapl_overnight_gap
lessons.lesson: Overnight gap relative to QQQ helped LR in 2023 but the sign of its effect (fade vs follow) changed in 2024, hurting badly.

lessons.name: peer_dispersion_5d
lessons.lesson: Absolute dispersion is unsigned and dominated by NVDA spikes, so it gave no direction and hurt in 2024.

factors.name: aapl_gap_sign_vs_prev_close
factors.hypothesis: The raw gap had outliers that made LR unstable in 2024; taking only the sign keeps the direction while removing the size outliers.

factors.name: aapl_close_position_zscore_5d
factors.hypothesis: Single-day close location is noisy; comparing it to its own 5-day average isolates unusual closes and should reduce regime flipping.

factors.name: aapl_close_vs_20d_high
factors.hypothesis: Drawdown from the 20-day high captures pullback and mean-reversion state, differing from the MA distance already present.

factors.name: qqq_close_to_ma20
factors.hypothesis: Market trend state gives context for whether Apple's drift persists; Apple-only trend measures already exist but the market's does not.

factors.name: aapl_minus_qqq_cum_5d
factors.hypothesis: Multi-day relative strength combined with intraday close location could separate real Apple weakness from market-driven moves, mean reverting when Apple has lagged.

factors.name: msft_volume_surge
factors.hypothesis: Peer volume surges flag information days; together with Apple's close location it may indicate whether the day's close is conviction or noise.
